 CBSE Class 10, 12 date sheet 2027: Exam timetable PDF likely to be released soon at cbse.gov.in
 CBSE is expected to release the 2027 Class 10 and 12 board exam date sheet by month-end. Students can download the PDF online and check required documents before exams.
 Curated by Yash Wardhan Singh 
 Image: iStock 
 Oct 28, 2026
 Share
 The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) is expected to announce the timetable for the 2027 board examinations soon. Based on the pattern followed in previous years, the date sheet may be released by the end of this month. Students will be able to access and download it from the official website, cbse.gov.in, once it is published. 
 Students will not need to sign in to any account or enter personal details to download the CBSE board exam date sheet 2027. The timetable will be available as a PDF file on the board’s official website. 
 CBSE Date Sheet 2027: Steps to Download the Timetable 
 Students can follow these steps to download the date sheet: 
 Step 1: Open the official CBSE website, cbse.gov.in. 
 Step 2: Look for the date sheet link on the homepage and select it. 
 Step 3: The date sheet PDF will open on the screen. 
 Step 4: Download the file and save it for later use. 
 The date sheet will include details such as the board’s name, examination name, subject codes, subject names, exam dates, timings and important instructions for exam day. 
 Documents Required for CBSE Board Exams 2027 
 The documents students need may differ based on whether they are regular or private candidates and the type of examination they are taking. Students should read the latest CBSE guidelines and check with their schools before registration or the examination. 
 1. Documents to Carry on Exam Day 
 Students must bring the following documents to their examination centre: 
 Admit Card: Regular students can collect their CBSE admit cards through their schools. Private candidates can download their admit cards directly. Read more about the CBSE date sheet. 
 School Identity Card: Regular students must carry their school ID card. 
 Valid Government-Issued Photo ID: Private candidates may need to show an Aadhaar card, passport or voter ID. 
 APAAR ID: Students should check the latest CBSE instructions to confirm whether an APAAR ID is required for the board exams. 
 2. Documents Needed for Registration and LOC Submission 
 During registration and the submission of the List of Candidates (LOC), schools may ask students for the following documents, depending on the rules that apply: 
 Marksheet of the Previous Class: Class 9 marksheet for Class 10 registration or Class 10 marksheet for Class 12 registration, as applicable. 
 Proof of Date of Birth: A birth certificate or another valid document showing the student's date of birth. 
 Aadhaar Card and APAAR ID Details: These may be required under the applicable CBSE registration rules. 
 Recent Passport-Sized Photographs: Photographs must follow CBSE guidelines. 
 Scanned Signature: Students may need to provide a scanned signature for online registration. 
 Caste Certificate: Required for students to whom this applies. 
 Disability Certificate: Students seeking eligible examination-related benefits may need to submit this certificate. 
 Migration Certificate: Students moving from another board may need to provide a migration certificate, depending on the admission and registration rules. 
 3. Extra Documents for Private Candidates 
 Private candidates may also need to provide the following documents, depending on their examination category: 
 School Leaving Certificate (SLC) or Transfer Certificate: Required where applicable. 
 Previous CBSE Marksheet or Admit Card: Candidates appearing for improvement or supplementary exams may need to submit these documents, as applicable. 
 Proof of Residence: An Aadhaar card, passport, voter ID or utility bill may be required to confirm the candidate's address.
